MODELS AND NODES USED IN THIS WORKFLOW

 Load CLIP (the model that looks at your pictures)

Download qwen3vl_8b_int8_convrot.safetensors9.35 GB  

Place in: ComfyUI/models/text_encoders

Qwen3-VL 8B is a language model that can see. It reads each picture and writes the text. If you already have it from the Qwen Image 2.1 workflows, it is the same file.

 After placing the files, restart ComfyUI or refresh model lists using the R shortcut.

{"version":1,"content":"

HOW TO USE

Ask a yes or no question about every picture in a folder and sort them by the answer, in one Run. Here: is there a person in it? The people go to one folder, the rest to another. Use it to clean a big folder: keep only the sharp ones, only the ones with a face, only the landscapes.

 Pick your folder

  1. On Load Images from Folder Pixaroma, click Browse and pick your folder, or paste the folder's path into the box.
  2. Click Pick images, then Select all, or click only the pictures you want. The button shows how many are picked.
  3. Press Run once. Leave the Run count at 1: the node sends every picture through by itself, one after the other.

This workflow opens with no folder picked: choose your own folder, or try it first on the demo folder Portraits inside the Media Inputs folder that comes with these workflows.

 A folder inside ComfyUI's own input or output folder works straight away. A folder anywhere else works too, but pick it once with Browse: that is how ComfyUI knows you allowed it.

 Pictures go through in name order. Name them 01_, 02_ and so on if the order matters.

 Ask your own question

  • Change the question in the formula, in the gear of AI Prompt Pixaroma, and keep the end: Answer with one word only: yes or no.
  • Questions that work: Is the picture sharp and in focus?, Is there any text or a watermark in the picture?, Is this a photo of food?, Is the main subject looking at the camera?
  • To keep the NO pictures instead, simply swap the two Save nodes' folders, or type no in Text Match.

 Good to know

  • The AI can be wrong on borderline pictures. Check the folders after a big Run.
  • Your original pictures are not moved: each one is saved as a copy into its folder.
  • Text Match works with any text, not only yes and no: it can look for several words and tells you which one it found.

 Something not working?

Each button opens the answer on the Pixaroma help page.

Folder not approved What AI Prompt needs Nodes look different from the video

{"version":1,"content":"

WHAT EACH NODE DOES

The colour of a node tells you what kind of node it is. Nothing here needs changing except the blue ones.

 Models to download

Orange. Each one needs a file from the Download Models note.

  • Load CLIP (Qwen3-VL 8B, looks at the pictures) - Qwen3-VL 8B, a language model that can SEE. It looks at each picture and answers the question. It runs on your own PC, nothing is sent online.

 The steps you set

Blue, and numbered. These are the only nodes you need to touch.

  • Load Images from Folder Pixaroma (1. your pictures) - Point it at the folder you want to sort and pick the pictures. Press Run once and it sends every picture through, one after the other.
  • AI Prompt Pixaroma (2. the yes or no question) - Shows each picture to Qwen3-VL with the yes or no question in its formula (the gear). Keep the question SIMPLE, and keep the last part: Answer with one word only: yes or no.
  • Text Match Pixaroma (3. the answer that keeps a picture) - Checks each answer for the word yes (mode is exactly one of them, so Yes. and YES count too). The picture goes in on value and comes out of if_match only on a yes, out of if_no_match only on a no.

 The result

Dark red, at the end.

  • Save Image Pixaroma (the pictures the AI said YES to) - Saves the pictures the AI said yes to into ComfyUI/output/With a Person, with their own names.
  • Save Image Pixaroma (the pictures the AI said NO to) - Saves the others into ComfyUI/output/Without a Person. Delete this node if you only want to KEEP the yes pictures.

 Readouts

Dark. Nothing to set: they show you what happened.

  • Run Timer - The dark clock above the result shows how long the last Run took.

RUN TIMES

Measured on a 24 GB RTX 4090 with this workflow, with the models already loaded. A different card gives different numbers, but the shape holds: the time grows with the number of pictures and their size.

WhatTime
Each answerunder 1 s
4 pictures (the demo)about 5 s

The answer is one word, so the AI is fast: a folder of 100 pictures takes about a minute. Qwen3-VL 8B needs about 10 GB of video memory.

 The first Run of the session

The first Run after starting ComfyUI also has to load the models from disk (about 18 GB for Klein and its text encoder), so it takes longer. After that they stay loaded.

 On a 16 GB card

Timed on an RTX 4060 Ti 16 GB with 32 GB of RAM:

  • The AI text step took about 2 times as long.
